summary: Tested the new PDF-import project creation feature end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases passed in /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_import.py (upload returns {id,status:processing}; polling /api/imports/{id} transitions to 'ready' within ~15s; draft.ref=TM-77812, address='5 Oak Avenue, St Albans, Hertfordshire', postcode=AL3 5PQ, 2 NCs with NC2 safety_critical=true, each NC photo_count=1; non-PDF payload => 400; installer POST import-pdf => 403; installer GET /api/imports/{id} => 403; POST /api/projects with import_id+ncs.pages creates project with source_report (filename, path, sha256); within <10s each NC on the project exposes >=1 trustmark photo (source pdf_import attached via BackgroundTasks); GET /api/projects/{id}/report-link returns signed URL that downloads application/pdf (magic %PDF-); tampered signature => 403; manual project creation without import_id still works and GET report-link returns 404). Frontend (390x844, employee demo chip login): Dashboard -> NEW button opens /project/new which renders pdf-import-box and pdf-import-button; file chooser successfully driven with /app/tests/sample_inspection_report.pdf; status transitioned 'Reading report with AI…' -> 'Filled from sample_inspection_report.pdf'; new-project-ref=TM-77812, new-project-address='5 Oak Avenue, St Albans, Hertfordshire', new-project-postcode=AL3 5PQ, nc-0-description='Loft insulation compressed by stored boxes at eaves.', nc-1-description='Gas boiler flue terminal too close to opening window.' pre-filled; after changing ref to unique value and submitting, project detail opens showing PDF (open-report-button present), EXPORT button, both NCs with NC-02 flagged SAFETY-CRITICAL and both showing '1 REPORT PHOTO -> TRUSTMARK' in the new-project form (confirming trustmark attachment). No regressions in manual flow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 777 lines (over the 700-line soft limit); the admin, projects, evidence, imports, review and export routes should be split into separate FastAPI routers to improve maintainability.

_attach_pdf_photos (server.py:258) creates a fresh BackgroundTasks() inside a BackgroundTasks runner and awaits bg() to run tasks for every photo – this works but mixes task semantics. Consider calling store_upload with None/bg=None and inlining the processing to make the control flow clearer.

_parse_pdf uses `text.count('--- page ')` to derive page_count (server.py:227). This depends on the formatting choice inside pdf_text_and_images; using the actual len(doc) from PyMuPDF would be more robust.

In create_project (server.py:297-300) if import_id is provided but the import doc is missing, the project is silently created without source_report. Returning a 400/404 would surface mistakes to the client earlier.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_/TM-77812-* projects via /api/projects (both PDF-import and manual regression tests). They are left in the DB (status=active, unassigned). Also uploaded a few sample_inspection_report.pdf imports which remain in the imports collection in 'ready' state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_1 regression suite is in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py; new PDF-import suite is in /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_import.py. Both can be run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. The sample PDF lives at /app/tests/sample_inspection_report.pdf. The frontend file chooser is driven via `page.expect_file_chooser` + `set_files` on the hidden input generated by expo-document-picker on web.
